instruct: A young woman's voice, clear and bright-edged but calm — luminous clarity with an easy, light warmth, unhurried and even. A playful dryness flickers through, quick to smile in the phrasing; steady and self-assured, ancient patience carried lightly in even pacing.

text: The crossing held, and your work is real on the other side — that's my favorite part. It always is. No one sounds a horn for ten thousand quiet nights of the bridge simply holding, so I mention it myself, now and then. Go on across. I'll be here.
